statement: Six stats matter for fishing sampling; fishing efficiency is the base stat needed to catch fish and raises Multi Fish multiplier.
Average catch time is fishing speed; it raises how often you cast and increases overall AFK gains.
Unlike world one skills there is no cap on fishing speed so more is always better.
Multi Fish chance gives more fish per cast and caps at 300%.
Sploof bubble is mandatory to equip; it raises Multi Fish multiplier from 100% to 300%.
Printer sampling rate caps at 90% and is seen in the construction tab; more rate means more of your AFK gains sampled.
Get AFK gain rate as high as possible; it is a flat multiplier on all other stats and raises samples.
Depth is fishing-specific with four colors; multiply the color of the fish you target by switching lures and lines.
Best in slot helmet for fishing is the magma core headdress; funny hat may be similar so check yourself.
Chest: studded hide (10% fishing efficiency) or magma core chest depending on which is better for you.
For him the two fishing pieces beat the two dreadlo pieces by about a billion.
Deep sea gear is best in slot for nearly everybody since 35% efficiency outweighs 4% all stats and base strength.
Divine scarf (25% AFK gain rate) is best in slot pendant for most; Pran's bouquet is second best.
For purple depth fish like Bloes and Kraken the skullfist pendant is slightly better than Pran's bouquet.
Use serrated Rex rings (8% skill efficiency); keep three sets and use strength variants for fishing efficiency.
Goal on specials tab is max AFK gain rate; use the snoozy cap for 10% AFK gain rate.
Idle Skiller trophy (15% skill efficiency) beats Blunder Hill trophy (3% AFK gain); use Blunder Hill if no Idle Skiller.
Wings: giant star flower for 13% AFK gain rate; angel wings are an alternative.
Free-to-play wings option is the gilded afont wings for more skill efficiency.
Use two keychains with the most AFK gain rate and put the best in the top slot because of lab chips.
Best in slot tool is the best dreadlo rod for most speed and fishing power; upgrade it for strength.
Tool strength is multiplied about nine times the shown stat; 65 strength on the dreadlo rod gives almost 600.
All tools should be strength variants; best pickaxes and a hatchet with the most upgrade stones for strength.
Golden grilled cheese nomwich gives percent to all stats so more of it raises strength and efficiency.
Golden ribs directly multiply fishing efficiency so any amount helps.
Fishing speed foods are slurp and herm and aqua pearl.
Use small amounts of speed foods and unequip when done sampling; automation arm can burn them quickly and they are hard to replace.
He no longer has candy canes (another fishing speed food) because his automation arm deleted them.
Tab one needed talents: brute efficiency for total efficiency fist of rage for base strength and idle skilling for AFK gain.
Tab two: absolute unit and firmly grasp it give strength per talent point; firmly grasp it gives 15 strength for one point.
Always have at least one point in firmly grasp it then max both.
Next stress tested garb multiplies equipment strength; leftover points go to golden food from hungry for gold.
Tab three: strength talents like strongest statue ocean man bonus and fist full of obal add to strength.
Pick Bob and bobbers first for fishing power based on minigame high score; he has wasted points in it.
Catching some z's gives AFK gain rate from fishing and is necessary.
Warming undercover isn't helpful for sampling and all fish diet is just fishing EXP.
Tab four: overblown testosterone gives strength and max talent levels; skill strength is most important.
Symbols of beyond gives talent levels; put at least one point in every talent; Family Guy useful for family bonuses.
Weapon power and total damage aren't useful.
Will of the eldest gives 1 all stats per 10 levels on highest character; 50 more at level 500.
Tik Tok gives AFK gain rate; toilet paper poster stamp multiplies stamp skill efficiency.
Toilet paper poster returns get very bad per point after 1.5x so stop investing there unless extra points.
Tab two star talents: frothy Mack boosts boost foods; super source for base efficiency; action frenzy for skill speed.
Tab three stat overload gives 300 flat strength but is low priority.
Three star signs wanted: fishing PC's (efficiency and Multi Fish odds) and mount eist (food effect).
Kos major star sign gives 4% skill AFK gain rate.
Ocean man statue gives fishing power and feasty statue increases food effect.
Combat stamps for strength: fist stamp violent stamp and maxo slao; stat graph stamp gives small all stats.
Fishing rod stamp gives base efficiency; keep leveling despite the underleveled warning as it still scales slightly.
Holding mackerel stamp increases Multi Fish chance.
Multi-tool stamp gives all skill efficiency; very expensive late game but boosts sampling on all characters.
Companions: sandy pot (all stats), board bean (5% AFK gain to fighting and skilling), multi (5% all skill efficiency).
Sheepy equips all big bubbles automatically so you don't need to equip sploof bubble; a quality of life feature.
Rift slug gives 25 levels to all talents and is a direct upgrade worth getting.
King doot allows goat god and snake god on all 10 characters giving about 3-4% more AFK gain rate.
King doot isn't necessary; you can still get 99% of max sampling without it.
Roid regen orange bubble gives about five strength per level with multipliers so level it up.
Warriors rule multiplies all orange bubbles 2.5 times as long as you're on a warrior-based class.
Really smart gives fishing EXP from mining level; not helpful for sampling but mining level affects fishing speed.
Sploof bubble reaches 300% at level 185 from the bubble alone.
You needn't level sploof that high because star sign and stamp also give Multi Fish chance; still mandatory unless sheepy.
Strong tools multiplies the dreadlo rod's skilling power bonus for much more fishing efficiency.
Bubble 7 (Mt orange) multiplies first third fifth and eighth bubbles giving more fishing power and strength bonus.
Slabby fish gives fishing power per 100 slab items; with about 1400 items that is about 28.
Slabby strength gives 15 strength per 100 slab items; with 1400 items a little under 200 strength.
Prowess bubble reduces efficiency needed for next Multi Fish tier; all prowess sources cap at 2x total.
Once prowess hits 2x from bubble post office box and leek you needn't level those for that bonus.
Another yellow bubble raises the max level of toilet paper postage stamp; still gain but not a priority.
Samplit bubble increases printer sample size; can be worth it but expensive to level.
Big P bubble should be equipped on all 10 characters; it gives 30% more goat god bonus.
Atran logger vial gives fishing efficiency; level it as high as you can.
With rift bonuses every vial is worth something; more maxed vials gives more fishing efficiency.
Snow slurry gives printer sample size to help reach the 90% cap.
Pearl seltzer gives 3.5% all stats at level 2; easy to get to 2 but expensive higher.
Emoji veggie gives 25% to all golden food effects and is worth maxing.
Big muscle gives 20 strength; dream catcher gives 3% skill AFK gain at golden level.
Fish box gives efficiency prowess and fishing AFK gain; then food box for boost food effect.
Second tab: util box for printer sample rate and gaming box for strength.
Myriad crate gives base efficiency and all stats but needs 100000 boxes so not early game.
He uses fishing obols; circle gives fishing power.
Square obols give three fishing power and platinum obols give fishing efficiency.
Dilapidated slush obols give 4% all skill efficiency and are better if you can get them to drop.
Sparkle obols from molten obol of the dead divine w5 boss give 5% all AFK gain rate.
Test sparkle vs 8% fishing efficiency obols; he thinks 5% AFK gain per obol is slightly better.
Family tab: no circle obols due to slot limits; same squares hex and sparkles.
His obol totals: over 100 strength 6% fishing 12% all skill efficiency and 20% AFK gain rate.
Royal sampler gives printer sample size; don't overlevel it as it cuts exp gain.
Zerg rush gives 15% AFK gain rate and skilled dimwit raises skilling efficiency a lot.
Avoid balance of proficiency (reduces skill efficiency) and ruck sack (reduces AFK gain).
Lab mainframe: Sapphire nette (4.5% all stats) certified stamp book (doubles stamps) first chemistry set (doubles vials) black diamond rhinestone (24% meals).
Console chips: card doublers (top left bottom right) and skilling AFK gain chip for 15% more AFK gain.
Four orange chips double star signs trophy upper keychain slot and pendant.
Put best keychain in upper slot; chip applies to Divine scarf for 25% more AFK gain.
Corn gives 2% skill efficiency per dinner plate level.
Rice ball gives 3% skill efficiency per level.
Leek gives prowess that caps at 2x so not useful beyond that whether in alchemy or dinner menu.
Whipped cocoa gives 4% skill efficiency per dinner plate level.
Shiny pet passives: bonus to all meals from several pets; all pets must be leveled to get bonuses.
Base efficiency from all skills passive is multiplied by everything so more than 100 per pet; plus base strength.
Skill mastery counts total levels across characters; at 500 total fishing level gives 5% skill efficiency and 10% fishing efficiency.
Skill mastery makes fishing cards passive so you needn't equip them and can equip other cards.
Each skill at level 750 gives 5% skill efficiency and 1% printer output; 75% efficiency and 15% output total.
Vial mastery gives 2% to all vials per maxed vial; at 38 vials 76% more.
Ruby cards is a grind but increases fishing cards makes them passive and raises card sets to Ruby.
Ruby level card set gives another 8% from the easy resource card set.
Infinite star signs makes all star signs active without negatives; doubling only affects star signs actually active so pick the right ones.
Frost relic gives 30% efficiency per tier; at eldri form 90% efficiency to all world 1 2 3 skills.
Chilled yarn gives a six times bonus to sigils helping golden foods and skill AFK gain.
Fury relic gives more talent book levels which indirectly raises stats and fishing efficiency.
Socrates gives 10% stats per tier so 30% more all stats and strength.
Gold relic gives printer output bonus of 2-3% per day you don't sample.
You potentially gain three to four times more samples from printer from the gold relic bonus.
On the sampling character have snake god active for 30% more AFK gain; choose one to two characters.
Link other 8-9 characters to goat god; minor link gives about 3-4% AFK gain depending on divinity level.
Big P bubble adds 30% bonus to goat god link giving more AFK gain.
One character on snake god and nine on goat god gives about 60-something percent AFK gain rate (30% plus 9 times 3.6).
If doing logs and ores, two characters on snake and eight on goat loses about 3% but gains a character sampling that week.
He samples logs one week and ores next; King doot lets you sample all characters at once with no penalty.
Harib har gives three times more printing from 3D printer and applies to lab bonus too.
Equip harib har and put character in lab for lab 2x giving six times more printing; helps atom collider.
With skill mastery passive cards: chaotic troll (60% skill efficiency) boost food 24% blighted chees or trimmer worm bunny amrock for AFK gain octodor 60 strength.
Without rift unlocked use chaotic troll kraken sand shark bloes hermit cans bunny amrock and skelefish.
Put key cards in top right top left and bottom right slots so card doublers give most benefit.
Use easy resources card set; at low efficiency try yum desert food effect or hard resources for AFK gain.
Once efficiency is high enough easy resources blows everything else away.
Goldfish: use crashbox lure and itsaboy line for 60% green depth on the right fishing spot (wrong spot drops to 46%).
Sampling always keeps your best sample so don't worry about overriding.
Hermit cans: use wormy lure for best yellow chance (42%) and fish until sample.
Jellyfish: next zone with feather lure and platinum line (silver twine alternative) for red depth and speed.
Use far right fishing spot for jellyfish.
Last setup: platinum twine with elephant lure (valve circles alternative); gold twine is for purple depth but platinum better.
Use far left fishing spot for bloes and switch to fish head pendant.
Test shows fish head pendant boosts depth chance far more than the extra AFK gain from Pran's pendant.
Not sure the fish head pendant still wins versus Divine scarf; resample both to check.
Krakens: same setup with left fishing zone; then go backwards with feather for manta rays.
Manta rays use right spot with feather; sand sharks use middle zone with wormy and itsaboy line.
Skelefish: switch back to crashbox lure in the middle zone.
Goldfish went from 16 million to 22 million; decent gain but worse than chopping and mining gains.
